slides.texte_overlay:
Things to do on your commute
instead of scrolling
Read a real book. Twenty minutes each way adds up to a book every two weeks. Your commute becomes the best reading time of your day.
Learn a language. Ten new words on the way to work, a quick review on the way home. In a year, you'll hold real conversations.
Plan your day. What are the three things that really matter today? Arriving with a clear plan makes the whole day smoother.
Call someone you care about. Parents, grandparents, an old friend. A ten-minute call on the way home keeps relationships strong.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Commutes stop feeling wasted when you arrive knowing something new.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Commutes stop feeling wasted when you arrive knowing something new.

slides.texte_overlay: Walk or cycle part of the way. Get off one stop early. Extra movement clears your head and helps your health. Fresh air helps too.
Just look out the window. Let your mind wander. Some of your best ideas will come when you're not trying to be productive.
